identity.mission: Create a clinical, trustworthy, and logistics-focused medical transport platform.
identity.vibe: Swiss Clinical x High-Speed Logistics. Sterile but fast.
identity.archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity) mixed with Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Logistics).

headings.usage: Headings, Data Values, KPIs. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode Default (Clinical Trust). Dark Mode for 'Night Drive' Dashboard only.
colors.gradients: NO generic gradients. Use subtle 'mesh' gradients only for Hero backgrounds (e.g., Slate 900 to Slate 800).

spacing.scale: Generous. Use p-8, p-12 for sections. p-6 for cards.
spacing.grid_gap: gap-6 or gap-8 for layouts. gap-4 for dense data grids.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Add Archivo and Public Sans to index.html or import in CSS.
SETUP TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Deep Navy' and 'Signal Blue' palette.
USE IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. DO NOT use placeholders.
ONTARIO CONTEXT: Ensure all copy refers to 'Ontario', 'GTA', 'Ministry of Transportation', 'CVOR', 'TDG'.
MEDICAL VIBE: Keep whitespace high. Avoid clutter. Think 'Sterile Cockpit'.
TESTIDS: Add data-testid to all buttons and inputs (e.g., 'login-btn', 'permit-upload').
NO GRADIENTS: Do not use gradient text. Keep it solid and high-contrast.
TOASTS: Use 'sonner' for notifications (e.g., 'New Job Available').
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' (generic centered layouts). Use asymmetry.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
